title: Form Energy
description: Plain industrial corporate: white and pale-grey bands, black ink, one warm orange for hairlines, outlined buttons, tag badges and every hover. Roboto Light for copy, Roboto Condensed uppercase for titles, Roboto Mono for every label; small 3–6px corners and no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling (black page, #1e1e1e bands, the same orange)
Roboto, Roboto Condensed and Roboto Mono are the original's own open faces
font-display is Roboto Condensed: meant for uppercase titles
page gutter widens from 1.875rem to 2.5rem at 1024px; section-y from 2.375rem to 6.875rem
name: formenergy-theme
